location_description: Asheville ( ASH-vil) is a city in, and the county seat of, Buncombe County, North Carolina, United States. Located at the confluence of the French Broad and Swannanoa rivers, it is the largest city in Western North Carolina, and the state's 11th-most populous city.  According to the 2020 United States Census, the city's population was 94,589, up from 83,393 in the 2010 census.
